Rule: G04 layer file must be stored in a restricted subfolder accessible only to Security Level 3 personnel
Rationale: Protects household location data from unauthorised access
Enforcement_Method: Folder-level permissions; do not share path in public documentation

Rule: G04 GIS project file must be separate from public/team GIS project files
Rationale: Prevents accidental exposure of household coordinates in shared project
Enforcement_Method: Maintain separate QGIS/GIS project for restricted layers

Rule: Household coordinates must NEVER appear in any public or Level 1 output
Rationale: Protects individual privacy and research ethics obligation
Enforcement_Method: Pre-publication privacy check (see PRIV07); automated flag in pipeline

Rule: Household coordinates must NEVER appear in any Level 2 (team) output without explicit approval
Rationale: Limits exposure even within project team
Enforcement_Method: Explicit sign-off required before any household spatial data is shared at Level 2

Rule: Public spatial representation of household data must use community centroid or approved jitter method
Enforcement_Method: Only aggregated/jittered outputs derived from G03 community centroid for public use

Rule: If jitter is applied to household points for publication: minimum jitter radius = 500m; maximum = 2000m; random direction; must not place points outside correct LGA
Rationale: Sufficient displacement to prevent re-identification while retaining spatial pattern
Enforcement_Method: Document jitter parameters and random seed in metadata; run spatial containment check after jitter

Rule: Before ANY output using G04 data is generated run: (1) confirm output is aggregated not point-level (2) confirm no Household_ID appears in output (3) confirm no coordinates traceable to individual household appear in output
Enforcement_Method: Checklist must be signed off and archived in 05_Analysis/04_QC/

Rule: G04 must not be spatially joined to external datasets in a way that could enable re-identification
Rationale: Prevents indirect identification through contextual data
Enforcement_Method: No spatial joins of G04 to building footprints (G17) or high-resolution imagery without PI approval

Rule: G04 backups must be encrypted and stored separately from non-restricted data backups
Rationale: Protects data in transit and at rest
Enforcement_Method: Encrypted backup volume; separate from 03_Data/RAW/ general backups

Rule: G04 data must be retained according to project ethics approval data retention schedule
Enforcement_Method: Review retention schedule at project close; destroy in line with ethics approval if required
